blurb: Guests can take private or group ballroom dance lessons following the DVIDA syllabus, progressing through bronze, silver, and gold levels. Wedding dance packages offer private lessons tailored to prepare couples for their first dance, including choreography and music editing. The studio also hosts semi-annual dance showcase performances and offers competitive dance training.
extraNote: Cancel private lessons or group classes anytime; full charge if private lesson canceled within 24 hours.
